Chemical Engineering.Fluid Mechanics and transport processes: Experimental investigations of multiphase flows, microfluidics, rheology, and transport phenomena in chemical processes.
Chemical Engineering.Biochemical and Bioprocess Engineering: Fermentation experiments, enzyme and cell culture studies, bioreactor testing, and downstream processing experiments.
Chemical Engineering.Energy and Fuel Processing: Experimental research on biofuels, hydrogen production, carbon capture, electrochemical energy conversion, and process integration.

Materials Engineering.Polymer and Polymeric Materials: Polymer synthesis, characterization (rheology, spectroscopy), processing experiments, and testing of mechanical, thermal, and electrical properties.
Materials Engineering.Composites and Advanced structured mater: Fabrication and experimental testing of fiber-reinforced composites, nanocomposites, layered structures, and functional material prototypes.
Materials Engineering.Nanomaterials and nanotechnology: Synthesis of nanoparticles, nanotubes, 2D materials, experimental surface and interface characterization, and device integration studies.
Materials Engineering.Materials characterization and testing: Use of X-ray diffraction, electron microscopy, spectroscopy, mechanical testing, and thermal analysis to experimentally determine material properties.
Materials Engineering.Materials for energy and sustainability: Experimental research on batteries, supercapacitors, fuel cells, photovoltaics, thermoelectrics, and sustainable material synthesis.

Chemical Biotechnology and Applied Chemi.Environmental and process chemistry: Experimental research on water treatment, air pollution control, waste processing, and sustainable chemical technologies.
Chemical Biotechnology and Applied Chemi.Polymer chemistry and functional materia: Experimental synthesis of functional polymers, responsive materials, and stimuli-sensitive coatings for applied engineering use.
